notes: Supply is the main problem, and the gate (tools/check-levels.mjs SUPPLY) will still fail after this repair. (1) Spirits: only 15 craft questions carry [spirits], but four at each of four levels needs 16. No set of moves can pass. Before the moves: I 4, II 7, III 4, IV 0, so the Level IV test (it deals 2 spirits questions) could not be dealt at all. After moves 1, 2 and 7: 4/4/4/3. The operator must write one more spirits question for Bar Manager (bottle book, allocation or sourcing) or lower SUPPLY. (2) The craft budget is floor(78/10) = 7, so moves 8 and 9 (stirred drink to III, oleo to III) are recorded but not applied. Level III then holds 1 technique and 1 prep question against 2 each. Apply them by hand: II keeps 4 of each. (3) Level IV started with 0 technique and 0 prep questions. Moves 3 to 6 bring each to 2. (4) Level IV Behind the Stick goes 4 to 6 with the two stick moves. Level IV shots goes 1 to 4. These are below their lessons, not above, and ties break down, so one option is to lower those cards. The Chartreuse and NOM questions now sit at IV, above prod:chartreuse (II) and the III agave producers and flight. That drift is caused by supply and goes away once a real IV spirits question exists.
